name: Brian Ortega

official.division_note: Featherweight; the Aug 2025 Sterling fight was moved to a catchweight. Last fought Aug 23, 2025 (UFC Shanghai, decision loss to Aljamain Sterling); out of planned 2026 bookings with Renato Moicano (UFC 326, UFC 331) through injury.

photo_coverage: Good; 9 photos. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Aug 2025), Sep 2024 official weigh-in (2880 px) and Feb 2024 beside Yair Rodriguez. Three-quarter: Aug 2025 media day and a 2018 CC BY 3.0 interview still (embed-ok, over-brightened). Profile: Aug 2025 faceoff (his right side, with the neck tattoo). Physique: ESPN cutouts (Feb 2024, Aug 2025) and the UFC 303 and UFC 306 weigh-ins. No 2026 photo: he has not fought since Aug 2025 and withdrew from his 2026 bookings.

face.shape: Long, rectangular face with a tall, broad forehead, long midface and a well-defined, angular jaw. Lean cheeks.
face.jaw: Defined and angular, medium-wide, with clear jaw angles below the ears.
face.cheekbones: High and visible, with flat to slightly hollow cheeks below.
face.brow_ridge: Noticeable; brows sit low on it, shading the eyes.
face.forehead: Tall and broad, made to look taller by the slicked-back hair; two or three horizontal creases.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow and deep-set; crow's feet when he smiles; mild under-eye creases.
eyes.colour: Light hazel: grey-green with a warm ring near the pupil. Closest embed iris: green (or grey).

eyebrows.shape: Low, straight and fairly level, with a short downward tail; inner ends moderately close.

nose.width: Medium; medium bridge and a rounded tip a little wider than the bridge.
nose.hump: Straight to very slightly convex in the August 2025 right profile.
nose.tip: Rounded, level to slightly down; medium nostrils.

face.mouth_lips: Wide mouth; thin upper lip, medium lower lip. Calm, closed-mouth resting expression; broad smile with even upper teeth in media photos.

ears.protrusion: Lie fairly close to the head.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Not obvious in the studio or 2025 photos at this resolution (low confidence for a BJJ black belt; check closer photos).

face.notable_marks_scars: Small sun spots / freckles on the cheeks and nose in the studio headshot; forehead creases. A blackletter script tattoo on the right side of the neck (see tattoos).

hair.style: Medium-long hair (about 15-20 cm on top) slicked straight back with product; often tied in a small top knot or low bun at weigh-ins (2018, 2024). Sides are combed back flat, not faded.
hair.colour: Dark brown, with lighter caramel-brown on the top layer where light catches it.
hair.hairline: Straight and fairly high, with mildly recessed temples (slight M shape) when slicked back.
hair.texture: Straight to slightly wavy, medium thickness; usually wet-look with gel.

facial_hair.colour: Light-to-medium brown with some grey mixed in at the chin and jaw (studio headshot, 2025).
facial_hair.colour_samples_note: Stubble boxes are mostly skin; colour_hex is a judged value.
facial_hair.density: Light to medium; even over the jaw, chin and upper lip, thinner on the cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 2-4 mm in 2025; a fuller short beard (about 8-10 mm) in 2018 and 2024.
facial_hair.shape: Even stubble with a low natural cheek line; moustache joined to the chin.

tone_samples.light: studio, high key, strong warm grade

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). The ESPN headshot is graded very warm and saturated (orange); the 2025 media still is flatter and cooler. The 2018 Commons still (wm-2018-mmanytt-interview.jpg) is over-brightened (forehead #f6f2f2) and was not sampled.
skin.undertone: Warm golden-peach with a sun tan; slight redness on the nose and cheeks.
skin.freckles_marks: Small sun spots / freckles on the cheeks and nose; forehead creases; dark arm and leg hair.
skin.tone_recommended_note: Judged: close to the raw average but pulled back from the orange ESPN grade. Same-photo check: in the Feb 2024 UFC Mexico City still (ref-ufcyt-2024-02-ufc-mexico-city-with-ortega.jpg) Yair and Ortega read almost the same lightness (foreheads #b3825e vs #b68169, chests #ca9b77 vs #c48d75), Yair slightly more golden and Ortega slightly pinker.

body.build: Medium frame, 173 cm with a 175 cm reach; compact and athletic.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean with visible abs and some serratus at the September 2024 weigh-in; softer, less sharply cut in the August 2025 studio shoot.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad for his height, rounded delts.
body.arms: Muscular but not bulky; defined forearms with visible veins; noticeable arm hair.
body.legs_calves: Medium-length legs with solid thighs and moderate calves; noticeable leg hair.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed, chin slightly raised in posed shots.
body.notable_physique_traits: Compact, evenly muscled BJJ build; long slicked-back hair; light eyes; neck script tattoo.

tattoos.where: Right side of the neck, below and slightly behind the ear
tattoos.description: Two short lines of small black blackletter (Old English) script; reads roughly 'gods warrior' at this resolution (low confidence on the words). Seen in August 2025 (media day and faceoff); not visible in the 2024 photos.
tattoos.size: About 5 cm wide x 3 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right arm, outer side just above the elbow
tattoos.description: Small black symbol or letters (not legible), seen in the August 2025 studio cutout and faceoff.

tattoos_note: Front of the torso, the left arm and the legs show no tattoos in the 2024-2025 photos.
accessories_seen: Silver cross pendant on a black cord (Feb 2024 ceremonial weigh-in).

kit.typical_shorts: Black UFC fight-kit shorts with ORTEGA in red down the left leg (Feb 2024 studio shoot); black shorts with a grey and white slash pattern printed 'UFC Shanghai' (Aug 2025). Black briefs on the scale. Fight-night colour follows the corner.

render_hints.hair: ponytail01 (tied back) or a long slicked-back cut, tinted #3a2a22 with lighter top highlights
render_hints.beard: stubble #5a463b, light; a few grey hairs at the chin
render_hints.tattoos: small two-line blackletter script on the right side of the neck below the ear (about 5 x 3 cm); a tiny mark above the right elbow. No sleeves or torso pieces.

stance.source: data/scouting/brian-ortega.json (archetype grappler/BJJ, stance switch; tags switch-stance, jab, slow-starter, late-surge; switch-stance jab-heavy boxing vs Chan Sung Jung) plus general knowledge of his fight footage. Not measured from these photos.
stance.notes: Patient switch-stance boxer: fairly tall stance, high tight guard, a measuring jab from either stance, steady rather than bouncy. Low output in 2024-2025 (out-landed 106-63 and 124-55), so feints and pressure stay modest.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, eyes, build and the neck-tattoo placement; medium for face proportions; medium-low for the morph values; the tattoo wording is a low-resolution read. What to watch: (1) long rectangular face with a tall forehead, angular jaw and lean cheeks; (2) light hazel/grey-green eyes under low, straight dark brows; (3) long dark-brown hair slicked straight back or tied up, lighter on the top layer; (4) light stubble with some grey at the chin; (5) blackletter script on the RIGHT side of the neck (2025 onward); (6) compact, evenly muscled body at 173 cm. The stance block starts him orthodox and switches about once a minute; it comes from data/scouting and general fight-footage knowledge, not from these photos. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65; l-/r- values are symmetric.
